preconditions.description: Attacker must NOT be the contract owner

exploit_hint: Call setMaxTxPercent(uint256) with any percentage value (e.g., 100 for 100%) or setMaxWalletPercent(uint256) as a non-owner address. These public functions lack the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to modify critical transfer limits (_maxTxAmount) and wallet holding limits (_maxWalletToken). Original _maxTxAmount is 15000000000000000 (15000 * 10^3 * 10^9).
